queries_run: Nucor distribution channel shift OR disruption 2026
Nucor business model transition platform OR subscription 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K 描述金屬建築產品主要經獨立建商經銷網路銷售，沿用既有通路模式。
findings.excerpt: The buildings are sold primarily through independent builder distribution networks in order to provide fast-track, customized solutions for building owners.

findings.claim: Q2 2026 10-Q：最大單一客戶約占銷售 5%，客戶集中度低。
findings.excerpt: Our largest single customer in the second quarter of 2026 represented approximately 5% of sales

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋未發現 Nucor 訂閱化、平台化、D2C 或去中介化的來源；搜尋結果僅顯示既有通路（服務中心、直接客戶）模式延續，無結構性轉移證據。
